protected_classes.dialogue: a line of dialogue, however short and however often quoted
protected_classes.lyric: song lyrics, which are licensed separately from everything else and rarely cheaply
protected_classes.slogan: a slogan or catchphrase, the class that feels most free and is not
protected_classes.work_title: the title of a film, series, book, album or game
protected_classes.distinctive_motif: a visual motif distinctive enough to identify its source

clearance_bases.public_domain: the work's own publication year, jurisdiction and the screen's result

clearance_bases.permissioned: who gave permission, when, in what form, and for which products
clearance_bases.brambleloop_original: the Brambleloop work it originates from, so the claim is checkable
clearance_bases.generic: why this phrase is ordinary language rather than a protected one, with the evidence that it is in common use outside the source

public_domain_screen.note: A deliberately conservative screen, not a clearance. Copyright term depends on authorship, work type, renewal and country; a system that computed a date from a year would be giving legal advice while sounding like arithmetic.

may_never: use a named character, likeness, quote, lyric, slogan, logo or title without a recorded basis
treat 'everyone else is doing it' as a basis
discard a cultural opportunity because its obvious execution is protected
rights.why: A pipeline optimising for demand finds that the strongest signals are all protected, and each step receives a slightly more abstract description of the same thing until it arrives at production having been refused by nobody. Nobody chose it; the gradient did.

routes.market_radar: a rising topic becomes a micro-market worth scoring

refuses: a topic flagged sensitive, whatever its momentum
a topic whose rights are unresolved, which goes to culture.rights and not to creative

findings.why_weights_are_unmeasured: #147 asks that outcomes update the cultural scoring weights so the system gets better at telling useful signals from noise. That needs launches and their results. Nothing has launched, so the weights are the ones the build started with -- said plainly rather than approximated, because a weight that moved for no reason looks exactly like a weight that learned

memory.note: The value of a culture radar is almost entirely in its second year. A radar with no memory rediscovers that retro Halloween recurs every autumn, every autumn, at full research cost (#144).

owned_territories.note: Eras and themes belong to nobody, recur annually, and cannot be withdrawn in January. Every product built on one is an asset this company keeps; every product built on a franchise is rented (#146).

primitives.emotion: what the person feels, stated as a feeling rather than a topic
primitives.setting: where it happens, concretely enough to draw
primitives.era: which reusable aesthetic territory it belongs to
primitives.humour_type: the shape of the joke, if there is one
primitives.colour_language: the palette the moment carries, as a language not a swatch
primitives.object_category: what physical object the feeling attaches to
primitives.ritual: the repeated act the moment is built around
primitives.visual_motif_class: the class of motif, never the distinctive one
primitives.gifting_context: who gives this to whom, and why that person

opportunity_components.search_momentum: how fast interest is rising, not how high it is
opportunity_components.recurrence: whether this comes back every year or happened once
opportunity_components.nostalgia_durability: whether the feeling outlives the moment
opportunity_components.seasonal_fit: whether it lands on a date people already buy for
opportunity_components.crochet_translatability: whether yarn is a good material for this idea
opportunity_components.giftability: whether somebody buys it for somebody else
opportunity_components.visual_recognisability: whether it reads in a thumbnail at 200 pixels
opportunity_components.product_family_potential: whether it supports a collection or one item
opportunity_components.make_time_window: whether a customer could still finish it in time
opportunity_components.rights_feasibility: whether this can be sold without somebody's permission

may_accelerate.research: start it now instead of at the next planning cycle
may_accelerate.concept_tournament: run more concepts in parallel rather than fewer rounds
may_accelerate.feasibility: compile the twin for several candidates at once
may_accelerate.creative_prototyping: prototype in parallel instead of sequentially
may_accelerate.asset_drafting: draft assets while the pattern is still certifying
may_accelerate.listing_copy: write it early; it still passes every claim gate before it is used

may_never_bypass.cir_validation: a pattern that was not validated is not a pattern, it is a document
may_never_bypass.product_truth: a claim nobody checked is a claim, and a customer will check it
may_never_bypass.creative_parity: the visual standard does not drop because the window is closing
may_never_bypass.policy_gate: the rights router is the reason this cell is allowed near culture at all
may_never_bypass.spend_ceilings: a closing window is the most persuasive possible argument for an unbudgeted spend, which is why the ceiling is in code
may_never_bypass.release_gates: the certificate is what a release is; issuing it early issues nothing
may_never_bypass.reverse_compilation: the document and the design must still agree
may_never_bypass.shadow_mode: a cultural window does not graduate a phase

rapid_response_cell.rule: speed comes from prioritization and parallelism, not lower standards (#141)

note: Cultural observation is demand evidence, never source material. A signal whose rights are unclear becomes an original concept rather than a dead opportunity, which is where the territories this company owns come from.
